heading: Questions about buying from the trays

items.question: How is a piece priced?
items.answer: Net gold weight times the day’s rate for its karat gives the gold value. The making charge for the work is added, then 5% VAT on both. The three figures appear as separate lines on the invoice so you can compare shops line by line. The rate is the Dubai Jewellery Group suggested retail rate, posted on our board each morning and on the gold-rate page.

items.question: Can I see a piece before I decide, at any branch?
items.answer: Yes. Send the reference on WhatsApp and name the branch you would like to visit: Gold Souq Extension in Deira, Safari Mall or Rolla Mall in Sharjah, or Madinat Zayed in Abu Dhabi. Stock differs by branch, so we will tell you whether the piece is there and, if not, whether it can be brought across and how long that takes. Viewing carries no obligation; we weigh the piece in front of you.

items.question: Do you make to order?
items.answer: Yes. Bring a sketch, a photo or an old piece to remake. We agree the karat, the weight, the making charge and the timeline in writing before any work begins, and you approve the design before anything is cast. For a wedding set, our advice is to start about three months before the date.
